scope: Actual complete accelerated trial, native exit0 independently retained by wrapper; no new solver calls. Scientific validation and reference-speed completion are not claimed.

native.nativeExitInterpretation: Not inferred from saved outputs; wrapper/process audit handled separately
native.loadingDeterminantJ: NOT_DIRECTLY_SAVED: positive volume ratio is not independent det(F) evidence

motionDefinition: ID-aligned final minus settled loading-frame0 particle centres; gravity movement excluded

contactGeometryIdentity.weights: Original top-particle overlap widths with patch[7,10]m; all six widths0.5m
contactGeometryIdentity.sourceInterpretation: Frozen boundary.top-point adds half current domain height to mp-position. Frozen vtk exports mp-domain-size as size vector and mp-position-trial as coordinates; update-particle-kirchoff copies updated mp-position into mp-position-trial before saved output. Data identity independently reproduces the recorded contact measurements across all61states.

nativePlasticLocalization.meaning: Native accumulated plastic history increment from settled frame0, not damage or Soil2 tensor history
nativePlasticLocalization.shearBandOrFailureMechanism: NOT_VERIFIED: increment concentration alone does not prove a throughgoing failure surface

contact.referenceComparison: No digitized/reference reaction target supplied; raw output is not paper-curve agreement
contact.reactionMeaning: Total actuator reaction, unit-thickness N/m; width-normalized value is mean applied stress, not deviatoric stress

energyObservations.energyClosure: NOT_VERIFIED: current-volume Hencky/native-plastic proxies omit a closed balance; prestress can mask inertia

comparisonWith005.alignment: Exact Decimal equality of saved commanded settlement and sorted native unique-id; no interpolation
comparisonWith005.rateConvergence: NOT_VERIFIED: observations only; no tolerance PASS assigned

comparisonWith002.alignment: Exact Decimal equality of saved commanded settlement and sorted native unique-id; no interpolation
comparisonWith002.rateConvergence: NOT_VERIFIED: observations only; no tolerance PASS assigned
